name: MulRan: Multimodal Range Dataset for Urban Place Recognition
description: Multimodal range dataset featuring 360-degree scanning radar (Navtech CIR204-H), 64-beam 3D LiDAR (Ouster OS1-64), and RTK-GPS/INS across 12 urban and campus driving sequences in South Korea with 6D ground truth trajectories for radar SLAM and place recognition.

publisher.name: KAIST / Seoul National University RPM Labs

source_references.title: MulRan Dataset Official Portal
source_references.notes: Official portal hosted by KAIST/SNU providing sequence downloads, calibration data, and baseline evaluation codes.

source_references.title: MulRan: Multimodal Range Dataset for Urban Place Recognition
source_references.notes: IEEE ICRA 2020 conference publication by Kim et al. detailing the sensor platform, 6D ground truth pose generation, and place recognition benchmarks.

verification.notes: Verified against official MulRan portal and IEEE ICRA 2020 publication (DOI: 10.1109/ICRA40945.2020.9197298).

size.notes: Distributed as separate download archives for radar, LiDAR, and navigation logs across 12 individual sequences.

citation.paper_title: MulRan: Multimodal Range Dataset for Urban Place Recognition

provenance.collection_method: Recorded with a 360-degree scanning radar (Navtech CIR204-H), 64-beam 3D LiDAR (Ouster OS1-64), and an RTK-GPS/INS navigation system (OXTS RT3003) across complex urban and riverside routes in South Korea.
provenance.curation_notes: Provides 12 sequences across four distinct environments (KAIST campus, Daejeon Convention Center, Riverside, and Sejong City) with cm-level 6D baseline trajectories, specifically targeted at radar-based and multimodal urban place recognition under visual and weather degradations.
data_sources: Mobile research vehicle equipped with scanning radar and LiDAR
